name: mabibby-stack
description: Matt Bibby's opinionated way of building web apps with Claude Code: Bun + Next.js + Postgres/Drizzle + better-auth + pg-boss + shadcn, local infra in Docker, deployed to Railway. One command to start a new app, one to build a feature, one to ship.

plugins.name: stack
plugins.description: Bootstrap and build web apps the Matt way: /stack:setup, /stack:new-app, /stack:start, /stack:feature, /stack:ship, /stack:status, /stack:undo, /stack:upgrade, /stack:db-change, /stack:deploy, /stack:doctor. Encodes the architecture so you can focus on product.
